"""Compare the actual complete finite32K first row; no corpus/256K/speed claim."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import math
import struct

B=Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
O=B/'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('paired_row_owner',O)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O)=='a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out=B/'main-layer-major-phase4k-prefix32k-paired-row-root-v1';assert not out.exists();out.mkdir()
    paths=[B/'main-phase-gated-quality-first-row-root-v1/record.json',B/'main-layer-major-phase4k-prefix32k-first-row-root-v1/record.json']
    records=[json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in paths]
    assert all(d['passed'] and d['complete'] and not d['active'] and d['actual_first_row_capture_qualified'] for d in records)
    assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] for d in records for c in d['commands'])
    assert all(d['normal_quit']['owner_closed'] and d['normal_quit']['reaped'] for d in records)
    assert records[0]['provider_hashes']==records[1]['provider_hashes']
    assert records[0]['fixture']==records[1]['fixture']
    assert records[0]['model-hashes-before']==records[0]['model-hashes-after']==records[1]['model-hashes-before']==records[1]['model-hashes-after']
    assert records[0]['requests'][1]['packet_sha256']==records[1]['requests'][1]['packet_sha256']
    ignored={'STRATA_SERVE_FIRST_ROW_DIR','STRATA_PREFILL_LAYER_MAJOR','STRATA_PREFILL_LAYER_MAJOR_R_GPU'}
    assert [{k:v for k,v in d['environment'].items() if k not in ignored} for d in records][0]==[{k:v for k,v in d['environment'].items() if k not in ignored} for d in records][1]
    assert records[0]['environment'].get('STRATA_PREFILL_LAYER_MAJOR','0')=='0'
    assert records[1]['environment']['STRATA_PREFILL_LAYER_MAJOR']=='1'
    assert records[1]['environment']['STRATA_PREFILL_LAYER_MAJOR_R_GPU']=='32768'
    baseline_argv=records[0]['engine_argv'][1:];candidate_argv=records[1]['engine_argv'][1:]
    at=candidate_argv.index('--vram-reserve-mib');assert candidate_argv[at+1]=='700'
    normalized=candidate_argv[:at]+candidate_argv[at+2:]
    ix=normalized.index('--prefill');assert normalized[ix+1]=='4096' and baseline_argv[baseline_argv.index('--prefill')+1]=='8192'
    normalized[ix+1]='8192'
    assert normalized==baseline_argv
    # Reviewed source defaults in the pinned K producer are700; same phase route
    # uses no automatic ordinary-cache shrinking. Explicit P reserve remains700.
    r=dict(active=False,passed=False,complete=False,main_reviewed=True,gpu_executed=False,model_executed=False,
           records=[dict(path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p)) for p in paths],
           controlled_treatment='layer-major full physical cache lease/fixed4096+full32767GPUresidual vs existing chunk-major phase/head path; same numeric model/input/context/providers; controlled chunk4096 vs8192, explicit700 vs pinned default700',
           quality_qualified=False,full_physical262144_qualified=False,restore_qualified=False,
           performance_eligible=False,performance_samples=[],adopted=False,
           scope='One actually retained32K first verifier row at position32767, full248320 FP32LE values; no whole generation/corpus capability proof')
    rows=[];raws=[]
    for d in records:
        c=d['captures'][1];p=Path(c['path']);raw=p.read_bytes()
        assert c['prompt_tokens']==32768 and c['predicted_position']==32767 and len(raw)==993288
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==c['sha256'] and struct.unpack_from('<ii',raw)==(248320,1)
        values=struct.unpack_from('<248320f',raw,8);assert all(math.isfinite(v) for v in values)
        rows.append(values);raws.append(raw)
    fixture_path=Path(records[0]['fixture']['path'])
    assert m.sha(fixture_path)==records[0]['fixture']['sha256'], 'current fixed-history fixture changed'
    ids=[int(x) for x in fixture_path.read_text().split()];target=ids[32768]
    scores=[]
    for row in rows:
        peak=max(row);normalizer=peak+math.log(math.fsum(math.exp(x-peak) for x in row))
        scores.append(dict(target=target,log_probability=row[target]-normalizer,nll=normalizer-row[target],
                           argmax=max(range(len(row)),key=row.__getitem__)))
    r.update(passed=True,complete=True,exact_bytes_equal=raws[0]==raws[1],
             max_absolute_logit_delta=max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(*rows)),
             target_scores=scores,nll_delta=scores[1]['nll']-scores[0]['nll'],
             capture_sha256=[hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() for raw in raws],bytes_per_capture=993288,
             shape=[1,248320],actual_prompt=32768,actual_position=32767,
             archival1024_fingerprint_match=records[0]['captures'][0]['sha256']==records[1]['captures'][0]['sha256'],
             archival1024_scope='Historical qualifiedK capture hash only; K1024 bytes retired, no fresh two-file comparison',finished_utc=m.utc())
    (out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({k:r[k] for k in ['passed','exact_bytes_equal','max_absolute_logit_delta','nll_delta','actual_prompt']}))
